title: Let sangat make peace audible in your tone
summary: The shabad joins holy company, Naam, and peace until remembrance reaches the sound of a person’s life. Speech becomes sweet because the heart has stayed near the saints and kept the Beloved within.
takeaway: Let sangat make peace audible in your tone.
lifeApplication: Before entering a tense exchange, inwardly sit with the company you want shaping you and let one remembered Name soften the first sound you make.

source.shortMeaning: Remaining with the saints and chanting Naam brings peace that reaches the heart and the way one speaks.
source.lifeApplication: Let remembered company shape your tone before the conversation begins.

evidence.coreClaim: The shabad shows peace as the fruit of sangat and Naam, not as a surface technique of politeness.
evidence.turn: Let holy company form the sound of the mouth before the mouth enters strain.
evidence.practicalImplication: Before entering a tense exchange, inwardly sit with the company you want shaping you and let one remembered Name soften the first sound you make.
